label: Camera frames synchronized to the process record
Frames on laser-on rows within a scan track
Eligible frames: finite, non-negative camera H and W
Track-edge rule: first and last eligible frame of each track excluded
Frames with undefined model geometry excluded and counted against coverage
Scored frame: log ratio of model to camera, for H and for W
Scan track: mean squared log ratio over the track's frames
Coupon: mean over the coupon's tracks
Process condition: mean over replicate coupons of the same condition
Analysis group: mean over the group's unique conditions
